scripts.title: FE Animation speed changer by DuaKNo
scripts.features:
Pretty simple you can change your animation speed (emote included)
Speed - changes your animation speed

Reverse - change your speed but in reverse so you do all your animations reversed

Low fps - glitchy animation (DEFAULT IS 0.1) if you increase your animation will be more glitchy and if you lower it, is gonna be less glitchy

local function notifyColor(text, color)
    task.spawn(function()
        local box = Instance.new("Frame")
        box.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
        box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24)
        box.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
        box.BorderSizePixel = 0
        box.Parent = notifHolder
        Instance.new("UICorner", box).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", box)
        stroke.Thickness = 2
        stroke.Color = color
        stroke.Transparency = 0.2
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
        lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Text = text
        lbl.TextColor3 = color
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
        lbl.TextSize = 13
        lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        lbl.Parent = box
        box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        stroke.Transparency = 1
        lbl.TextTransparency = 1
        T:Create(box, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.1}):Play()
        T:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Transparency = 0.2}):Play()
        T:Create(lbl, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
        task.wait(2)
        T:Create(box, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
        T:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
        T:Create(lbl, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
        task.wait(0.4)
        box:Destroy()
    end)
end

local fly=false
local flySpd=50
local flyC,flyBV,flyBG
local flyAnimTrack

local function stopFly()
    fly=false
    if flyAnimTrack then pcall(function() flyAnimTrack:Stop() end) flyAnimTrack=nil end
    if flyC then flyC:Disconnect() flyC=nil end
    local ch=LP.Character
    if ch then
        local hrp=ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then hrp.Anchored=false end
        local hm=ch:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if hm then hm.PlatformStand=false end
    end
end

local function startFly()
    local ch = getCh()
    local hrp = ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hm = ch:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    hm.PlatformStand = true
    hrp.Anchored = true
    local animator = hm:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if animator then
        local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
        anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://507766666"
        local track = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
        track.Looped = true
        track:Play()
        flyAnimTrack = track
    end
    local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local plrControls
    local ok2, res = pcall(function() return require(plr.PlayerScripts.PlayerModule.ControlModule) end)
    if ok2 then plrControls = res end
    flyC = R.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not fly then return end
        if not plrControls then return end
        local h2 = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not h2 then return end
        local moveDir = plrControls:GetMoveVector()
        local camCF = C.CFrame
        local newPos = h2.Position
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
            local camRotation = camCF - camCF.Position

local function applySize(scale)
    local ch = LP.Character
    if not ch then return end
    local hm = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hm then return end
    local isR15 = ch:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") ~= nil
    if isR15 then
        hm.BodyDepthScale.Value = scale
        hm.BodyHeightScale.Value = scale
        hm.BodyWidthScale.Value = scale
        hm.HeadScale.Value = scale
    else
        local cache = origSizeCache[ch]
        if not cache then
            cacheCharacter(ch)
            cache = origSizeCache[ch]
        end
        for part, origSize in pairs(cache) do
            if part and part.Parent then
                part.Size = origSize * scale
            end
        end
    end
end

local function getPlayerTeam(p)
    return p.Team
end

local function isTeammate(p)
    if not teamCheckOn then return false end
    if not LP.Team then return false end
    if not p.Team then return false end
    return LP.Team == p.Team
end

local function getBodyPart(char, boneName)
    if not char then return nil end
    if boneName == "Head" then
        return char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    else
        return char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    end
end

local function isVisibleFromCamera(part)
    if not wallCheckOn then return true end
    if not part then return false end
    local cam = C
    local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
    local targetPos = part.Position
    local dir = (targetPos - origin)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LP.Character}
    local result = W:Raycast(origin, dir, params)
    if not result then return true end
    return result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(part.Parent)
end

local function getPriorityPlayer(players)
    if #players == 0 then return nil end
    if aimPriority == "Nearest" then
        local myHrp = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myHrp then return players[1] end
        local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
        for _, p in pairs(players) do
            local hrp = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                local d = (hrp.Position - myHrp.Position).Magnitude
                if d < bestDist then best, bestDist = p, d end
            end
        end
        return best
    elseif aimPriority == "Lowest HP" then
        local best, bestHP = nil, math.huge
        for _, p in pairs(players) do
            local hm = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hm and hm.Health < bestHP then best, bestHP = p, hm.Health end
        end
        return best
    elseif aimPriority == "Closest to Crosshair" then
        local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
        local center = C.ViewportSize / 2
        for _, p in pairs(players) do
            local part = getBodyPart(p.Character, aimBone)
            if part then
                local sp, onScreen = C:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                if onScreen then
                    local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                    if d < bestDist then best, bestDist = p, d end
                end
            end

local function getPlayersInFov()
    local list = {}
    local center = C.ViewportSize / 2
    for _, p in pairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LP and p.Character then
            if not isTeammate(p) then
                local part = getBodyPart(p.Character, aimBone)
                if part and isVisibleFromCamera(part) then
                    local sp, onScreen = C:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                    if onScreen then
                        local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                        if d <= aimFov then
                            table.insert(list, p)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return list
end

mkLabel(CombatPage,"HITBOX")

local hitboxOn = false
local hitboxSize = 5
local hitboxConns = {}

local function restoreHitbox(p)
    local char = p.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp and hrp:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig") then
        hrp.Size = hrp:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig")
    end
    for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig") then
            part.Size = part:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig")
            local masslessAttr = part:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrigMassless")
            local canCollideAttr = part:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrigCanCollide")
            if masslessAttr ~= nil then part.Massless = masslessAttr end
            if canCollideAttr ~= nil then part.CanCollide = canCollideAttr end
        end
    end
end

local function applyHitbox(p)
    if p == LP then return end
    local char = p.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp then
        if not hrp:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig") then
            hrp:SetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig", hrp.Size)
        end
        hrp.Size = hrp:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig") + Vector3.new(hitboxSize, hitboxSize, hitboxSize)
    end
    for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= hrp and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
            if not part:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig") then
                part:SetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig", part.Size)
                part:SetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrigMassless", part.Massless)
                part:SetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrigCanCollide", part.CanCollide)
            end
            local orig = part:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig")
            part.Size = orig + Vector3.new(hitboxSize, hitboxSize, hitboxSize)
            part.CanCollide = false
            part.Massless = true
        end
    end
end

    hitboxOn = on
    for _, c in pairs(hitboxConns) do c:Disconnect() end
    hitboxConns = {}
    if on then

                local c = p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

        table.insert(hitboxConns, newConn)
        notify("Hitbox Expander: ON")
    else
        for _, p in pairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LP then restoreHitbox(p) end
        end
        notify("Hitbox Expander: OFF")
    end
end)

local bonesR6={
    {"Head","Torso"},
    {"Torso","Left Arm"},
    {"Torso","Right Arm"},
    {"Torso","Left Leg"},
    {"Torso","Right Leg"},
}

local function addSkeleton(p)
    if not skeletonOn or p==LP or not p.Character then return end
    if skeletonData[p] then return end
    local char=p.Character
    local isR15 = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") ~= nil
    local boneList = isR15 and bones or bonesR6
    local lines={}
    for _=1,#boneList do
        local line = Drawing.new("Line")
        line.Visible=false
        line.Color=rgbC(espColors.skel)
        line.Thickness=1
        line.Transparency=1
        table.insert(lines, line)
    end
    skeletonData[p]={lines=lines, boneList=boneList}
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if skeletonOn then
            local cam=C
            for p,data in pairs(skeletonData) do
                local char = p.Character
                if char then
                    for i,bone in pairs(data.boneList) do
                        local part1=char:FindFirstChild(bone[1])
                        local part2=char:FindFirstChild(bone[2])
                        local line=data.lines[i]
                        if part1 and part2 and line then
                            local pos1,on1=cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part1.Position)
                            local pos2,on2=cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part2.Position)
                            if on1 and on2 and pos1.Z>0 and pos2.Z>0 then
                                line.From=Vector2.new(pos1.X, pos1.Y)
                                line.To=Vector2.new(pos2.X, pos2.Y)
                                line.Visible=true
                            else
                                line.Visible=false
                            end
                        elseif line then
                            line.Visible=false
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        task.wait()
    end
end)

do
mkLabel(WorldPage,"WEATHER (Can Cause lag and fps drops)")

local weatherInstances = {}
local weatherConn = nil
local weatherParts = {}
local weatherPartSpeed = 0
local weatherPartSway = false
local thunderActive = false
local rainSound = nil

local function track(inst)
    table.insert(weatherInstances, inst)
    return inst
end

local function spawnLightningBolt(basePos)
    local boltFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    boltFolder.Name = "RichieBolt"
    boltFolder.Parent = W
    track(boltFolder)
    local startPos = basePos + Vector3.new(math.random(-120,120), 260, math.random(-120,120))
    local endPos = basePos + Vector3.new(math.random(-40,40), 25, math.random(-40,40))
    local segments = 14
    local points = {}
    for i = 0, segments do
        local t = i / segments
        local pos = startPos:Lerp(endPos, t)
        if i > 0 and i < segments then
            pos = pos + Vector3.new(math.random(-8,8), 0, math.random(-8,8))
        end
        table.insert(points, pos)
    end
    for i = 1, #points - 1 do
        local p1 = points[i]
        local p2 = points[i+1]
        local mid = (p1 + p2) / 2
        local dist = (p2 - p1).Magnitude
        local seg = Instance.new("Part")
        seg.Anchored = true
        seg.CanCollide = false
        seg.CanQuery = false
        seg.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        seg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(230,230,255)
        seg.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, dist)
        seg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(mid, p2)
        seg.Parent = boltFolder
    end
    task.delay(0.25, function()
        if boltFolder and boltFolder.Parent then boltFolder:Destroy() end
    end)
end

local function stopWeather()
    thunderActive = false
    if weatherConn then weatherConn:Disconnect() weatherConn=nil end
    for _, inst in pairs(weatherInstances) do
        if inst and inst.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                if inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then inst:Clear() end
                inst:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
    weatherInstances = {}
    weatherParts = {}
    weatherPartSpeed = 0
    weatherPartSway = false
    if rainSound then rainSound:Stop() rainSound:Destroy() rainSound=nil end
    L.FogStart = origFogStart
    L.FogEnd = origFogEnd
    L.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(192,192,192)
    L.Brightness = origBright
    local atm = L:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
    if atm then atm.Density = 0.3 atm.Haze = 0 end
end

local function buildRain(hrp, count, isSnow)
    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name = isSnow and "RichieSnow" or "RichieRain"
    folder.Parent = W
    track(folder)
    local base = hrp.Position
    for i = 1, count do
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        if isSnow then
            p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            p.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
            p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            p.Transparency = 0.15
        else
            p.Size = Vector3.new(0.15, 0.15, 3)
p.Orientation = Vector3.new(90, 0, 0)
            p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180,200,255)
            p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            p.Transparency = 0.35
        end
        p.Anchored = true
        p.CanCollide = false
        p.CanQuery = false
        p.CanTouch = false
        p.Parent = folder
        p.Position = Vector3.new(
            base.X + math.random(-200,200),
            base.Y + math.random(20,200),
            base.Z + math.random(-200,200)
        )
        table.insert(weatherParts, p)
    end
    weatherPartSpeed = isSnow and 0.6 or 8
    weatherPartSway = isSnow
end

local function startWeather(kind)
    stopWeather()
    if kind == "Clear" then notify("Weather: Clear") return end
    local ch = LP.Character or LP.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local hrp = ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
    if not hrp then notify("Character not ready") return end

    if kind == "Fog" then
        L.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,205)
        L.FogStart = 0
        L.FogEnd = 60
        local atm = L:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
        if atm then atm.Density = 1 atm.Haze = 5 atm.Glare = 0 atm.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,205) end
        notify("Weather: Fog")
        return
    end

    if kind == "Rain" or kind == "Thunder" then
        buildRain(hrp, 250, false)
        rainSound = Instance.new("Sound")
        rainSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9064263922"
        rainSound.Volume = 0.6
        rainSound.Looped = true
        rainSound.Parent = SG
        rainSound:Play()
        track(rainSound)
        L.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(120,130,140)
        L.FogStart = 0
        L.FogEnd = 250

        if kind == "Thunder" then
            L.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,40)
            L.FogEnd = 180
            L.Brightness = 0.4
            thunderActive = true
            task.spawn(function()
                while thunderActive do
                    task.wait(math.random(3,7))
                    if not thunderActive then break end
                    local c = LP.Character
                    local h = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if h then spawnLightningBolt(h.Position) end
                    local flash = Instance.new("Frame")
                    flash.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
                    flash.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                    flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
                    flash.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    flash.ZIndex = 999
                    flash.Parent = SG
                    L.Brightness = 7
                    task.wait(0.06)
                    flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
                    L.Brightness = 2.5
                    task.wait(0.06)
                    flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
                    L.Brightness = 5
                    task.wait(0.05)
                    flash:Destroy()
                    L.Brightness = 0.4
                    local thunder = Instance.new("Sound")
                    thunder.SoundId = "rbxassetid://139968319088532"
                    thunder.Volume = 1
                    thunder.Parent = SG
                    thunder:Play()
                    task.spawn(function()
                        task.wait(6)
                        if thunder then thunder:Destroy() end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end
        notify("Weather: "..kind)
    elseif kind == "Snow" then
        buildRain(hrp, 320, true)
        L.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(220,225,235)
        L.FogStart = 0
        L.FogEnd = 300
        notify("Weather: Snow")
    end

    weatherConn = R.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local c = LP.Character
        if not c then return end
        local h = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not h then return end
        local base = h.Position
        local sway = tick()
        for _, p in pairs(weatherParts) do
            if p and p.Parent then
                local np = p.Position - Vector3.new(0, weatherPartSpeed, 0)
                if weatherPartSway then
                    np = np + Vector3.new(math.sin(sway + p.Position.X) * 0.05, 0, math.cos(sway + p.Position.Z) * 0.05)
                end
                if np.Y < base.Y - 20 then
                    np = Vector3.new(
                        base.X + math.random(-200,200),
                        base.Y + 150,
                        base.Z + math.random(-200,200)
                    )
                elseif (np - base).Magnitude > 350 then
                    np = Vector3.new(
                        base.X + math.random(-200,200),
                        base.Y + 150,
                        base.Z + math.random(-200,200)
                    )
                end
                p.Position = np
            end
        end
    end)
end

mkBtn(WorldPage,"Rain",function() startWeather("Rain") end)
mkBtn(WorldPage,"Snow",function() startWeather("Snow") end)
mkBtn(WorldPage,"Fog",function() startWeather("Fog") end)
mkBtn(WorldPage,"Thunder",function() startWeather("Thunder") end)
mkBtn(WorldPage,"Clear Weather",function() startWeather("Clear") end)
_G.richieWeatherCleanup = stopWeather

end

local function getConfigList()
    local list={}
    pcall(function()
        if isfile(CONFIG_INDEX) then
            local content=readfile(CONFIG_INDEX)
            for name in content:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
                table.insert(list, name)
            end
        end
    end)
    return list
end

local function saveConfigList(list)
    pcall(function()
        writefile(CONFIG_INDEX, table.concat(list, "\n"))
    end)
end

local function resolveTarget(q)
    if not q or q=="" then return nil,"" end
    q=q:lower()
    for _,p in pairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
        if p~=LP and p.Name:lower()==q then return p,p.Name end
    end
    local m={}
    for _,p in pairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
        if p~=LP and p.Name:lower():sub(1,#q)==q then table.insert(m,p) end
    end
    if #m==1 then return m[1],m[1].Name end
    if #m==0 then return nil,"" end
    return nil,"user not found."
end

local multiSelected = {}

local multiOn = {esp=false, box=false, name=false, health=false, dist=false}
local multiGuis = {}

local function destroyMultiData(p)
    local data = multiGuis[p]
    if not data then return end
    if data.hl then data.hl:Destroy() end
    if data.nameBg then data.nameBg:Destroy() end
    if data.box then data.box:Destroy() end
    if data.hpBg then data.hpBg:Destroy() end
    if data.distBg then data.distBg:Destroy() end
    if data.hpConn then data.hpConn:Disconnect() end
    multiGuis[p] = nil
end

local function clearAllMultiData()
    for p, _ in pairs(multiGuis) do
        destroyMultiData(p)
    end
    multiGuis = {}
end

local function applyMultiFeatures(p)
    if not p.Character then return end
    local char = p.Character
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or hrp
    local hm = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") or char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not head or not hm then return end

    local data = multiGuis[p] or {p = p}

local function onKeyPress(input)
    if not listeningForKey then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
    local key=input.KeyCode
    local btn=listeningBtn
    if unsupportedKeys[key] then
        btn.Text="Not Allowed"
        btn.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,80,80)
        task.wait(1)
        btn.Text="+"
        btn.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(220,220,220)
        listeningForKey=nil
        listeningBtn=nil
        return
    end
    if key==Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end
    for otherFeature, boundKey in pairs(keybindData) do
        if otherFeature ~= listeningForKey and boundKey == key then
            btn.Text="In Use"
            btn.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,80,80)
            task.wait(1)
            btn.Text="+"
            btn.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(220,220,220)
            listeningForKey=nil
            listeningBtn=nil
            return
        end
    end
    keybindData[listeningForKey] = key
    btn.Text=key.Name
    btn.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(80,200,120)
    listeningForKey=nil
    listeningBtn=nil
end

U.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
    if listeningForKey then
        onKeyPress(input)
        return
    end
    for featureName, key in pairs(keybindData) do
        if input.KeyCode==key then
            if keybindTargets[featureName] then
                local tgt=keybindTargets[featureName]
                local current = _G.richieToggleState[featureName]
                if current == nil then current = false end
                local newState = not current
                _G.richieToggleState[featureName]=newState
                tgt.setState(newState)
                if tgt.onChange then tgt.onChange(newState) end
                notify(featureName .. ": " .. (newState and "ON" or "OFF"))
            elseif keybindButtons[featureName] then
                local info=keybindButtons[featureName]
                if info.fire then info.fire() end
                notify(featureName .. ": fired")
            end
        end

Send.TextColor3 = WHITE
Send.TextSize = 14
Send.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Send.Parent = Main

Instance.new("UICorner",Send).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,15)

--==================================================
-- SELECTED PLAYER
--==================================================

local SelectedPlayer = nil

local function UpdateAvatar(player)

	if not player then
		Avatar.Image = ""
		return
	end

	local ok,url = pcall(function()

		return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(
			player.UserId,
			Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot,
			Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size100x100
		)

	end)

	if ok then
		Avatar.Image = url
	end

end

local function UpdatePreview()

	local name = SelectedPlayer and SelectedPlayer.DisplayName or "You"
	local msg = MessageBox.Text

	if msg == "" then
		msg = "..."
	end

	Preview.Text = "   " .. name .. ": " .. msg

end

MessageBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(UpdatePreview)

--==================================================
-- PLAYER LIST
--==================================================

local function RefreshPlayers()

	for _,child in ipairs(Dropdown:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("TextButton") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

		local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
		Button.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,38)
		Button.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL
		Button.Text = "  " .. player.DisplayName .. "  @" .. player.Name
		Button.TextColor3 = WHITE
		Button.TextSize = 12
		Button.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		Button.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		Button.ZIndex = 21
		Button.Parent = Dropdown

		Instance.new("UICorner",Button).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,10)

		Button.Activated:Connect(function()

			SelectedPlayer = player

			PlayerButton.Text =
				"👤  " ..
				player.DisplayName

			PlayerButton.TextColor3 = WHITE

			UpdateAvatar(player)
			UpdatePreview()

			Dropdown.Visible = false

		end)

	end

	Dropdown.CanvasSize =
		UDim2.fromOffset(0,Layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 15)

end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(RefreshPlayers)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)

	if SelectedPlayer == player then
		SelectedPlayer = nil
		PlayerButton.Text = "👤  Select a player..."
		PlayerButton.TextColor3 = GRAY
		Avatar.Image = ""
		UpdatePreview()
	end

	RefreshPlayers()

end)

PlayerButton.Activated:Connect(function()

	RefreshPlayers()

	Dropdown.Visible = not Dropdown.Visible

end)

--==================================================
-- SHOW MESSAGE
--==================================================

local function ShowMessage(target,message)

	if not target or message == "" then
		return
	end

	-- Chat window
	local channels = TextChatService:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")

	if channels then

		local general = channels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")

		if general then

			general:DisplaySystemMessage(
				"<font color='#FFFFFF'>" ..
				target.DisplayName ..
				": " ..
				message ..
				"</font>"
			)

		end

	end

	-- Bubble
	local character = target.Character

	if character then

		local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")

		if head then
			TextChatService:DisplayBubble(head,message)
		end

	end

end

Send.Activated:Connect(function()

	-- Blank player = yourself
	local target = SelectedPlayer or LP
	local message = MessageBox.Text

	if message == "" then

		Send.Text = "⚠  TYPE A MESSAGE"

		task.wait(.8)

		Send.Text = "⚡  SEND TO CHAT + BUBBLE"

		return
	end

	ShowMessage(target,message)

	MessageBox.Text = ""

	Send.Text = "✓  SENT"

	TweenService:Create(
		Send,
		TweenInfo.new(.12),
		{Size = UDim2.new(1,-45,0,48)}
	):Play()

	task.wait(.15)

	TweenService:Create(
		Send,
		TweenInfo.new(.12),
		{Size = UDim2.new(1,-30,0,55)}
	):Play()

	task.wait(.5)

	Send.Text = "⚡  SEND TO CHAT + BUBBLE"

end)

--==================================================
-- MINIMIZE
--==================================================

local minimized = false

Min.Activated:Connect(function()

	minimized = not minimized

	for _,obj in ipairs(Main:GetChildren()) do

		if obj ~= Top and obj ~= Glow then
			obj.Visible = not minimized
		end

	end

	Main.Size = minimized
		and UDim2.fromOffset(470,72)
		or UDim2.fromOffset(470,410)

	Min.Text = minimized and "+" or "—"

end)

--==================================================
-- CLOSE / REOPEN
--==================================================

local Reopen = Instance.new("TextButton")
Reopen.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(68,68)
Reopen.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20,180)
Reopen.BackgroundColor3 = BG
Reopen.Text = "⚡"
Reopen.TextSize = 30
Reopen.Visible = false
Reopen.Parent = GUI

Instance.new("UICorner",Reopen).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)

local ReopenStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
ReopenStroke.Color = BLUE
ReopenStroke.Thickness = 2
ReopenStroke.Parent = Reopen

Close.Activated:Connect(function()

	Main.Visible = false
	Reopen.Visible = true

end)

Reopen.Activated:Connect(function()

	Main.Visible = true
	Reopen.Visible = false

end)

--==================================================
-- DRAGGING — MOBILE + PC
--==================================================

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPos

Top.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = Main.Position

	end

end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if not dragging then
		return
	end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		Main.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)

	end

end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = false

	end

end)

--==================================================
-- START
--==================================================

RefreshPlayers()
UpdatePreview()

local function rotateCamera(deg)
	local root = Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end

	local newCFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(deg), 0) * Camera.CFrame
	Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position) * newCFrame.Rotation
end

local function restoreCamera()
	rotateCamera(-45)  -- left
	wait(0.000000000001)
	rotateCamera(45)   -- back right (net 0°)
end

-- Keybind (Press R to rotate)
local KEYBIND = Enum.KeyCode.R

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == KEYBIND then
		restoreCamera()
	end
end)

Simple Tool Teleport Script Open Sourced.













#tool #teleport #noclip #fly #speed #jump
scripts.script:
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LP = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local Cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

local char = LP.Character or LP.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
tool.Name = "Teleport Tool"
tool.RequiresHandle = false
tool.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("Backpack")

local function tp(pos)
	local ray = Cam:ViewportPointToRay(pos.X, pos.Y)
	local rp = RaycastParams.new()
	rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char, Cam}
	rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 5000, rp)
	local p = hit and hit.Position or ray.Origin + ray.Direction * 5000
	local _, y = root.CFrame:ToOrientation()
	root.CFrame = CFrame.new(p) * CFrame.Angles(0, y, 0)
end

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
	if UIS.TouchEnabled then return end
	tp(UIS:GetMouseLocation())
end)

UIS.TouchTap:Connect(function(t, g)
	if g or tool.Parent ~= char or #t == 0 then return end
	tp(Vector2.new(t[1].X, t[1].Y))
end)

task.spawn(function() hum:EquipTool(tool) end)

D9.Funcs.RegisterText = function(element)
    table.insert(D9.Cache.AllTextElements, element)
    pcall(function() element.Font = D9.DB.Fonts[D9.Config.FontIndex].val end)
end

D9.Funcs.ApplyGlobalFont = function()
    local font = D9.DB.Fonts[D9.Config.FontIndex].val
    for _, el in ipairs(D9.Cache.AllTextElements) do pcall(function() el.Font = font end) end
end

D9.Funcs.CreateHover = function(button)
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    local hoverFrame = Instance.new("Frame", button)
    hoverFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    hoverFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    hoverFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hoverFrame.ZIndex = button.ZIndex + 1
    Instance.new("UICorner", hoverFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    
    button.MouseEnter:Connect(function() D9.Core.TS:Create(hoverFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.92}):Play() end)
    button.MouseLeave:Connect(function() D9.Core.TS:Create(hoverFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play() end)
    button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() 
        pcall(function() local snd = Instance.new("Sound", D9.Core.Snd); snd.SoundId = "rbxassetid://6895079853"; snd.Volume = 0.3; snd:Play(); game.Debris:AddItem(snd, 1) end)
        D9.Core.TS:Create(hoverFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.8}):Play()
        D9.Core.TS:Create(button, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {Size = UDim2.new(button.Size.X.Scale, button.Size.X.Offset - 2, button.Size.Y.Scale, button.Size.Y.Offset - 2)}):Play() 
    end)
    button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() 
        D9.Core.TS:Create(hoverFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.92}):Play()
        D9.Core.TS:Create(button, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Bounce), {Size = UDim2.new(button.Size.X.Scale, button.Size.X.Offset + 2, button.Size.Y.Scale, button.Size.Y.Offset + 2)}):Play() 
    end)
end

D9.Funcs.CreateButton = function(parent, text, height)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", parent)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, height or 35)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = D9.Theme.ButtonBase
    btn.TextColor3 = D9.Theme.TextWhite
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextSize = 12
    btn.ZIndex = 50 
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
    stroke.Color = D9.Theme.Stroke
    stroke.Transparency = 0.2
    D9.Funcs.RegisterText(btn)
    D9.Funcs.CreateHover(btn)
    return btn
end

D9.Funcs.SetActive = function(btn, text, color)
    btn.Text = text
    D9.Core.TS:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {BackgroundColor3 = color}):Play()
    local s = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if s then s.Color = color; s.Transparency = 0.1 end
end

D9.Funcs.SetInactive = function(btn, text)
    btn.Text = text
    D9.Core.TS:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {BackgroundColor3 = D9.Theme.ButtonBase}):Play()
    local s = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if s then s.Color = D9.Theme.Stroke; s.Transparency = 0.2 end
end

    local fpad = Instance.new("UIPadding", sf); fpad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10); fpad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 15)

    D9.Funcs.RegisterText(secTitle)
    
    table.insert(D9.UI.TabBtns, btn); table.insert(D9.UI.TabCnts, {frame = sf, color = color})
    
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for i, b in ipairs(D9.UI.TabBtns) do

    return sf

D9.Funcs.AutoWlk = function(pos)
    local c = D9.Core.Player.Character; if not c then return end; local h = c:FindFirstChild("Humanoid"); local hrp = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not h or not hrp then return end
    local p = D9.Core.Pathfinding:CreatePath({AgentRadius = 2, AgentHeight = 5, AgentCanJump = true})
    pcall(function() p:ComputeAsync(hrp.Position, pos) end)
    if p.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        local wps = p:GetWaypoints(); D9.Config.AIWalking = true
        task.spawn(function()
            for i = 1, #wps - 1 do local w1 = wps[i].Position; local w2 = wps[i+1].Position; local d = (w1 - w2).Magnitude; local l = Instance.new("Part", workspace); l.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, d); l.CFrame = CFrame.new(w1, w2) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -d/2); l.Anchored = true; l.CanCollide = false; l.Material = Enum.Material.Neon; l.Color = D9.Theme.AccentCyan; table.insert(D9.Cache.VisualPath, l) end
            for _, wp in ipairs(wps) do if not D9.Config.AIWalking then break end; if wp.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then h.Jump = true end; h:MoveTo(wp.Position); h.MoveToFinished:Wait() end
            D9.Config.AIWalking = false; D9.Funcs.AddMsg("System", L("Маршрут завершен.", "Route finished."), D9.Theme.AccentGreen); for _, l in ipairs(D9.Cache.VisualPath) do l:Destroy() end; D9.Cache.VisualPath = {}
        end)
    else D9.UI.CPrF.Visible = true end
end

D9.Funcs.PAICmd = function(t)
    t = string.lower(t)
    if string.find(t, "привет") or string.find(t, "hello") then return L("Привет! Напиши 'команды'.", "Hi! Type 'commands'.")
    elseif string.find(t, "кто ты") or string.find(t, "who") then return L("Я Deskret9 AI. Управляю читами и строю лазерные пути.", "I am Deskret9 AI. I manage cheats and build laser paths.")
    elseif string.find(t, "совет") or string.find(t, "tip") then return D9.DB.Tips[math.random(1, #D9.DB.Tips)]
    elseif string.find(t, "команд") or string.find(t, "command") then return L("Команды: 'вкл полет', 'выкл полет', 'вкл есп', 'выкл есп', 'иди к [имя]', 'сделай день', 'очисти чат', 'стоп'.", "Commands: 'fly on/off', 'esp on/off', 'go to [name]', 'day time', 'clear chat', 'stop'.")
    elseif string.find(t, "полет") or string.find(t, "fly") then if string.find(t, "вкл") or string.find(t, "on") then D9.Funcs.TogFly(true); return L("Полет активирован.", "Fly ON.") elseif string.find(t, "вык") or string.find(t, "off") then D9.Funcs.TogFly(false); return L("Полет отключен.", "Fly OFF.") end
    elseif string.find(t, "есп") or string.find(t, "esp") then if string.find(t, "вкл") or string.find(t, "on") then D9.Funcs.TogEspM(true); return L("ESP включен.", "ESP ON.") elseif string.find(t, "вык") or string.find(t, "off") then D9.Funcs.TogEspM(false); return L("ESP отключен.", "ESP OFF.") end
    elseif string.find(t, "сделай день") or string.find(t, "day") then pcall(function() D9.Core.Lighting.ClockTime = 12 end); return L("Время установлено на день.", "Set to day time.")
    elseif string.find(t, "очисти чат") or string.find(t, "clear") then for _, c in ipairs(D9.UI.CDs:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("Frame") then c:Destroy() end end; return L("Чат очищен.", "Chat cleared.")
    elseif string.find(t, "иди к") or string.find(t, "go to") then local tn = string.match(t, "иди к (%S+)") or string.match(t, "go to (%S+)"); local fP = nil; for _, p in ipairs(D9.Core.Players:GetPlayers()) do if string.lower(string.sub(p.Name, 1, #tn)) == tn or string.lower(string.sub(p.DisplayName, 1, #tn)) == tn then fP = p; break end end; if fP and fP.Character and fP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then D9.Funcs.AutoWalkTo(fP.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position); return L("Прокладываю маршрут к ", "Routing to ") .. fP.Name else return L("Не смог найти игрока.", "Player not found.") end
    elseif string.find(t, "стоп") or string.find(t, "stop") then D9.Config.AIWalking = false; for _, l in ipairs(D9.Cache.VisualPath) do l:Destroy() end; D9.Cache.VisualPath = {}; return L("Остановлено.", "Stopped.") end
    return L("Напиши 'команды', чтобы увидеть список.", "Type 'commands' for a list.")
end

    if gp or D9.Core.UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= nil then return end
    D9.Cache.KeysDown[i.KeyCode] = true
    local k = i.KeyCode
    if k == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl or k == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift or k == Enum.KeyCode.Insert then D9.Funcs.ToggleMinimize()

end)

local function parts()
	local out = {}
	local maps = workspace:FindFirstChild("Maps")
	if not maps then
		return out
	end
	for _, mf in ipairs(maps:GetChildren()) do
		local tf = mf:FindFirstChild("Targets")
		if tf then
			for _, t in ipairs(tf:GetChildren()) do
				local p = t:FindFirstChild("Primary")
				if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
					table.insert(out, p)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return out

local function closest(list)
	local center = camera.ViewportSize * 0.5
	local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
	for _, p in ipairs(list) do
		local sp, on = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(p.Position)
		if on and sp.Z > 0 then
			local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
			if d < bestD then
				bestD, best = d, p
			end
		end
	end
	return best, bestD
end

-- config save
local function serialize()
	local t = {}
	for k, v in pairs(C) do
		if typeof(v) == "EnumItem" then
			t[k] = { __enum = tostring(v.EnumType), name = v.Name }
		else
			t[k] = v
		end
	end
	return HttpService:JSONEncode(t)
end

local function applyConfig(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	for k, v in pairs(data) do
		if C[k] ~= nil then
			if type(v) == "table" and v.__enum and v.name then
				local ok, ev = pcall(function()
					return Enum[v.__enum][v.name]
				end)
				if ok and ev then
					C[k] = ev
				end
			else
				C[k] = v
			end
		end
	end
	activeSmooth = C.smooth
end

local function saveConfig()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if writefile then
			writefile(CONFIG_FILE, serialize())
		else
			G.__AimConfigSave = serialize()
		end
	end)
	if ok then
		print("config saved")
	else
		warn("ave failed:", err)
	end
end

local function loadConfig()
	local ok, raw = pcall(function()
		if isfile and isfile(CONFIG_FILE) and readfile then
			return readfile(CONFIG_FILE)
		elseif G.__AimConfigSave then
			return G.__AimConfigSave
		end
		return nil
	end)
	if not ok or not raw or raw == "" then
		print("no config found")
		return false
	end
	local ok2, data = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
	end)
	if not ok2 or type(data) ~= "table" then
		warn("config corrupt")
		return false
	end
	applyConfig(data)
	print("config loaded")
	return true
end

local function startAim()
	if not C.enabled then
		return
	end
	aiming = true
	accX, accY = 0, 0
	stepX, stepY = 0, 0
	startT = os.clock()
	phase = math.random() * 100
	doOvershoot = math.random() < C.overshootChance
	overshootDone = false
	lastTarget = nil
	stopUntil = 0
	wiggleX, wiggleY = 0, 0
	trigStart = os.clock()
	activeSmooth = C.smoothSwitch and C.smoothA or C.smooth
	nextSwitchAt = os.clock() + C.switchMin + math.random() * math.max(C.switchMax - C.switchMin, 0)
	lastSmoothIdx = 1
end

local function stopAim()
	aiming = false
	accX, accY = 0, 0
	stepX, stepY = 0, 0
	lastTarget = nil
	if trigHolding then
		mouseUp()
		trigHolding = false
	end
end

local function pickRandomSmooth()
	local vals = { C.smoothA, C.smoothB, C.smoothC }
	-- random index, prefer not same as last (but allow if only one)
	local idx = math.random(1, 3)
	if idx == lastSmoothIdx then
		idx = (idx % 3) + 1
		-- 50% chance still allow same for true randomness
		if math.random() < 0.5 then
			idx = math.random(1, 3)
		end
	end
	lastSmoothIdx = idx
	return vals[idx], idx
end

local function addSlider(name, key, minV, maxV, decimals)
	decimals = decimals or 2
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 52)
	row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 40)
	row.BorderSizePixel = 0
	row.Parent = body
	corner(row, 6)

	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 20)
	lbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 4)
	lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	lbl.TextSize = 12
	lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220)
	lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	lbl.Parent = row

	local function fmt(v)
		if decimals <= 0 then
			return tostring(math.floor(v + 0.5))
		end
		local m = 10 ^ decimals
		return string.format("%." .. decimals .. "f", math.floor(v * m + 0.5) / m)
	end

	local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
	bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 8)
	bar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 32)
	bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 62)
	bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bar.Parent = row
	corner(bar, 4)

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 140, 255)
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.Parent = bar
	corner(fill, 4)

	local function refresh()
		local v = C[key]
		lbl.Text = name .. "  " .. fmt(v)
		local rel = math.clamp((v - minV) / math.max(maxV - minV, 1e-6), 0, 1)
		fill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
	end
	refresh()
	sliderRefresh[key] = refresh

	local dragging = false
	local function setFromX(x)
		local rel = math.clamp((x - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
		C[key] = minV + (maxV - minV) * rel
		refresh()
	end

	bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = true
			setFromX(input.Position.X)
		end
	end)
	track(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = false
		end
	end))
	track(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			setFromX(input.Position.X)
		end
	end))
end

track(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	local want = C.enabled and UIS:IsKeyDown(C.aimKey)
	if want and not aiming then
		startAim()
	elseif not want and aiming then
		stopAim()
	end

	dt = math.clamp(dt, 1 / 240, 1 / 20)
	local now = os.clock()
	local center = camera.ViewportSize * 0.5
	local plist = parts()
	local target, dist = closest(plist)
	dist = dist or math.huge

	-- random smoothness switch (not sequential)
	if C.smoothSwitch and aiming and now >= nextSwitchAt then
		local val = pickRandomSmooth()
		activeSmooth = val
		local span = math.max(C.switchMax - C.switchMin, 0.05)
		nextSwitchAt = now + C.switchMin + math.random() * span
	elseif not C.smoothSwitch then
		activeSmooth = C.smooth
	end

	if aiming and now - startT >= C.reaction and target then
		if now < stopUntil then
			stepX, stepY = stepX * 0.3, stepY * 0.3
		elseif math.random() < C.stopChance then
			stopUntil = now + C.stopDuration * (0.7 + math.random() * 0.6)
		end

		if target ~= lastTarget then
			lastTarget = target
			doOvershoot = math.random() < C.overshootChance
			overshootDone = false
			phase = math.random() * 100
		end

		local sp, on = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(target.Position)
		if on and sp.Z > 0 then
			local dx = sp.X - center.X
			local dy = sp.Y - center.Y
			dist = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)

			local t = now - startT
			local ws = C.wiggleSpeed
			local w = C.wiggle
			local targetWX = (math.sin(t * ws + phase)
				+ math.sin(t * ws * 0.37 + phase * 2.1) * 0.55
				+ math.sin(t * ws * 1.7 + phase * 0.5) * 0.25) * w
			local targetWY = (math.cos(t * ws * 0.9 + phase * 1.3)
				+ math.sin(t * ws * 0.51 + phase * 0.7) * 0.55
				+ math.cos(t * ws * 1.4 + phase) * 0.25) * w
			wiggleX = wiggleX + (targetWX - wiggleX) * math.clamp(dt * 8, 0, 1)
			wiggleY = wiggleY + (targetWY - wiggleY) * math.clamp(dt * 8, 0, 1)

			local blend = math.clamp(1 - (dist / math.max(C.closePx, 1)), 0, 1)
			blend = blend * blend
			local gain = C.gainFar + (C.gainClose - C.gainFar) * blend

			if doOvershoot and not overshootDone and dist >= C.overshootMin then
				gain = gain * C.overshootScale
				if dist < C.overshootMin * 0.6 then
					overshootDone = true
				end
			end

			if dist <= C.curveRadius then
				gain = math.min(gain, C.gainClose * 0.85)
			end

			local sUse = activeSmooth
			local gainCap = 0.9 + math.clamp(sUse - 1, 0, 1) * 0.08
			gain = math.clamp(gain, 0.05, gainCap)

			local desiredX = (dx + wiggleX) * gain
			local desiredY = (dy + wiggleY) * gain

			local sVal = math.max(sUse, 0.05)
			local sBase = math.clamp(sVal, 0.05, 1)
			local sBoost = math.max(sVal - 1, 0)
			local sm = 1 - (1 - sBase) ^ (dt * 60)
			local lockMul = 1 + sBoost * 1.35
			desiredX = desiredX * sm * lockMul
			desiredY = desiredY * sm * lockMul

			local resp = 1 - math.exp(-C.response * dt)
			stepX = stepX + (desiredX - stepX) * resp
			stepY = stepY + (desiredY - stepY) * resp

			if dist < 6 then
				stepX = stepX * 0.55
				stepY = stepY * 0.55
			end

			local mag = math.sqrt(stepX * stepX + stepY * stepY)
			if mag > C.maxStep and mag > 0 then
				local s = C.maxStep / mag
				stepX, stepY = stepX * s, stepY * s
			end

			if now < stopUntil then
				stepX, stepY = stepX * 0.15, stepY * 0.15
			end

			accX = accX + stepX
			accY = accY + stepY
			local mx = (accX >= 0) and math.floor(accX) or math.ceil(accX)
			local my = (accY >= 0) and math.floor(accY) or math.ceil(accY)
			if mx ~= 0 or my ~= 0 then
				mousemoverel(mx, my)
				accX = accX - mx
				accY = accY - my
			end
		end
	end

	local canTrig = C.trigEnabled
	if C.trigHoldOnlyAim then
		canTrig = canTrig and aiming
	end
	local onTarget = target and dist <= C.trigRadius

	if canTrig and onTarget and (now - trigStart) >= C.trigDelay then
		if C.trigMode == "Hold" then
			if not trigHolding then
				mouseDown()
				trigHolding = true
			end
		else
			if trigHolding then
				mouseUp()
				trigHolding = false
			end
			local interval = 1 / math.max(C.trigCps, 1)
			if now >= nextClick then
				clickOnce()
				nextClick = now + interval
			end
		end
	else
		if trigHolding then
			mouseUp()
			trigHolding = false
		end
	end
end))

-- Mecânica de voo
local function getHRP()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function getHumanoid()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local DIRECTIONS = {
    Left = Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0),
    Right = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0),
    Forwards = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
    Backwards = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1),
    Up = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0),
    Down = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
}

local function getCF(part, isFor)
    local cframe = part.CFrame
    local noRot = CFrame.new(cframe.p)
    local x, y, z = (Camera.CFrame - Camera.CFrame.p):toEulerAnglesXYZ()
    return noRot * CFrame.Angles(isFor and z or x, y, z)
end

local function getNextMovement(deltaTime, spd)
    local nextMove = Vector3.new()
    local humanoid = getHumanoid()
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not humanoid or not hrp then return CFrame.new(), nextMove end

    local md = humanoid.MoveDirection

    for dirName, vector in pairs(DIRECTIONS) do
        local isFor = (dirName == "Forwards" or dirName == "Backwards")
        local worldVector = ((getCF(hrp, isFor) * CFrame.new(vector)) - hrp.CFrame.p).p
        if (worldVector - md).magnitude <= 1.05 and md ~= Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) then
            nextMove = nextMove + vector
        end
    end

    if upPressed then nextMove = nextMove + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
    if downPressed then nextMove = nextMove + Vector3.new(0, -1, 0) end

    return CFrame.new(nextMove * spd * deltaTime), nextMove
end

local function applySitAnim(humanoid)
    if not humanoid then return end
    humanoid.Sit = true
    humanoid.PlatformStand = false
end

local function removeSitAnim(humanoid)
    if not humanoid then return end
    humanoid.Sit = false
end

local function startFly()
    local hrp = getHRP()
    local humanoid = getHumanoid()
    if not hrp or not humanoid then return end

    flying = true
    tiltAmount = 0

    flyForce = Instance.new("BodyPosition")
    flyForce.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    flyForce.Position = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, FLY_HEIGHT_OFFSET, 0)
    flyForce.Name = "HDAdminFlyForce"
    flyForce.Parent = hrp

    bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bodyGyro.D = 50
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bodyGyro.P = 200
    bodyGyro.Name = "HDAdminFlyGyro"
    bodyGyro.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
    bodyGyro.Parent = hrp

    if flyMode == 2 then
        applySitAnim(humanoid)
    end

    local lastUpdate = tick()
    local lastPosition = hrp.Position
    local static = 0

    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flying then return end

        local currentHrp = getHRP()
        local currentHumanoid = getHumanoid()
        if not currentHrp or not currentHumanoid then return end

        local delta = tick() - lastUpdate
        local look = (Camera.Focus.p - Camera.CFrame.p).unit
        local move, directionalVector = getNextMovement(delta, speed * 10)

        local pos = currentHrp.Position
        local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(pos, pos + look) * move
        local targetD = 750 + (speed * 0.2)

        if move.p ~= Vector3.new() then
            static = 0
            flyForce.D = targetD
            tiltAmount = tiltAmount + TILT_INCREMENT
            flyForce.Position = targetCFrame.p
        else
            static = static + 1
            tiltAmount = 1
            local mag = (currentHrp.Position - lastPosition).magnitude
            if mag > 6 and static >= 4 then
                flyForce.Position = currentHrp.Position
            end
        end

        if math.abs(tiltAmount) > TILT_MAX then
            tiltAmount = TILT_MAX
        end

        if flyForce.D == targetD then
            local tiltZ = tiltAmount * directionalVector.Z
            bodyGyro.CFrame = targetCFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(tiltZ), 0, 0)
        end

        lastUpdate = tick()
        lastPosition = currentHrp.Position

        if flyMode == 2 then
            if not currentHumanoid.Sit then
                currentHumanoid.Sit = true
            end
            currentHumanoid.PlatformStand = false
        else
            currentHumanoid.PlatformStand = true
            currentHumanoid.Sit = false
        end
    end)
end

local function stopFly()
    flying = false

    if flyConnection then
        flyConnection:Disconnect()
        flyConnection = nil
    end

    if flyForce then flyForce:Destroy(); flyForce = nil end
    if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy(); bodyGyro = nil end

    local humanoid = getHumanoid()
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.PlatformStand = false
        humanoid.Sit = false
        removeSitAnim(humanoid)
    end

    upPressed = false
    downPressed = false
end

local function openPanel()
    MainFrame.Visible = true
    MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    MainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    tw(MainFrame, 0.35, {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 240),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -120),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0
    }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
end

local function closePanel()
    local t = tw(MainFrame, 0.25, {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1
    }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
    t.Completed:Connect(function()
        MainFrame.Visible = false
    end)
end

local dragging, dragStart, startPos
Header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        dragging = false
    end
end)
